_meta.purpose: Canonical venue, hall, and seating section reference for The Bushnell Center for the Performing Arts. Single source of truth for section names and seat counts used by box_office.html and factsheets.json. Broadway touring and one-nighter events share these physical spaces; this file defines the spaces independent of any single event type.
_meta.notes: Section names here are the official Bushnell section map canonical names (read from the color-coded SECTION MAP, scan_Randale Nunley_*.pdf p.3). Fact sheets and subscriber pricing sheets use different naming conventions for the same physical sections — see nameAliases on each section for known variants. Any lookup code that joins this file to factsheets.json pricing keys MUST fall back through nameAliases before reporting a miss.

_reconciliationNotes.summary: Sections reconciled 2026-06-30 against official Bushnell SECTION MAP (scan p.3). All 10 misnamed sections corrected to official canonical names; prior fact-sheet names moved to nameAliases. Two structural issues require human confirmation — see _needsHumanConfirmation.

seatCountVerification.mezzanine: CONFIRMED: Prime Mezzanine (156) + Front Mezzanine (238) + Middle Mezzanine (314) + Rear Mezzanine (280) = 988 = physical mezzanine total (Front 556 + Rear 432). No excluded seats at mezzanine level.
seatCountVerification.balcony: CONFIRMED: Prime Balcony (83) + Front Balcony (195) + Mid/Rear Balcony (276) + Rear Balcony (98) = 652 = physical balcony total (Front 333 + Rear 319). No excluded seats at balcony level.
seatCountVerification.orchestra: UNRESOLVED: Orchestra sections sum to 1,064 vs physical orchestra 1,159. Pit (77) is excluded from standard sellable inventory for most configurations. Remaining 18-seat gap between physical non-pit orchestra (1,082) and orchestra sections (1,064) is unresolved. See _needsHumanConfirmation[1].
seatCountVerification.grandTotal: Sellable 2,704 vs physical 2,799. Difference = 95, entirely attributable to orchestra level: Pit (77) + unexplained 18-seat gap.

_reconciliationNotes.namingConventionChange: Fact sheets use '[Location] – [Type]' word order (e.g. 'Orchestra Prime', 'Mezzanine – Front'). Official Bushnell section map uses '[Type] [Location]' order (e.g. 'Prime Orchestra', 'Front Mezzanine'). All 10 misnamed sections updated to official map order. Fact-sheet names retained as nameAliases. IMPORTANT: factsheets.json pricing objects key on the old fact-sheet names. Any code doing exact-string lookups against factsheets.json pricing keys must traverse nameAliases as a fallback before reporting a miss.
_reconciliationNotes.economyToRearRename: Three sections previously labeled 'Economy' renamed to physically descriptive 'Rear' to match official map: 'Mezzanine – Economy' → 'Rear Mezzanine'; 'Balcony – Economy' → 'Rear Balcony'; 'Balcony – Middle' → 'Mid/Rear Balcony'.
_reconciliationNotes.rearOrchestraBoxGap: The official section map includes 'Rear Orchestra/Box' as a distinct color zone with no corresponding entry in venues.json. The physical Parterre Boxes (60 seats per house chart) are the most likely candidate for this zone. The current 'Prime Orchestra' section (684 seats) may combine two distinct official map zones: 'Prime Orchestra' (center/front rows) and 'Rear Orchestra/Box' (rear orchestra rows + Parterre Boxes). This cannot be resolved without a row-level seat manifest. See _needsHumanConfirmation[0].

_needsHumanConfirmation.issue: 'Rear Orchestra/Box' zone not split out from 'Prime Orchestra'
_needsHumanConfirmation.detail: The official SECTION MAP shows 'Rear Orchestra/Box' as a distinct colored zone separate from 'Prime Orchestra'. The current 'Prime Orchestra' section (684 seats) likely combines these two zones. The physical house chart shows 60 Parterre Box seats (labeled 'parterreBox') that may be entirely or partly within 'Rear Orchestra/Box'. Without a row-level seat-assignment manifest the exact split cannot be determined.
_needsHumanConfirmation.interpretationA: 'Rear Orchestra/Box' = the 60 Parterre Box seats only. Then 'Prime Orchestra' = 684 − 60 = 624 seats.
_needsHumanConfirmation.interpretationB: 'Rear Orchestra/Box' = Parterre Boxes (60) + rear-center orchestra rows (unknown count). 'Prime Orchestra' < 624.
_needsHumanConfirmation.interpretationC: Both zones are priced identically in all fact sheets and can remain combined at 684 for revenue modeling; 'Rear Orchestra/Box' is noted as a sub-zone alias only.
_needsHumanConfirmation.confirmWith: Bushnell box office staff or Archtics/TM zone code manifest; compare zone codes against the section map color boundaries

_needsHumanConfirmation.detail: Physical non-pit orchestra seats: 986 (main) + 60 (Parterre Box) + 8 (wheelchair) + 28 (companion/accessible) = 1,082. Sellable orchestra sections: Prime Orchestra (684) + Side Orchestra (88) + Broadway Circle (244) + ADA/Accessible (48) = 1,064. Gap = 18 seats not accounted for in any section. Pit (77) accounts for the remaining 95-seat difference from the 2,799 physical total.
_needsHumanConfirmation.likelyExplanation: 18 companion/accessible seats that are neither in the ADA/Accessible sellable section nor in any standard-pricing section — possibly fixed non-sale positions (director's box, production hold) or counted differently between the house chart and the ticketing manifest.
_needsHumanConfirmation.confirmWith: Bushnell box office staff — ask for the orchestra-level accessible seat breakdown and whether any non-sale fixed positions exist in the orchestra

_reconciliationNotes.pitDiscrepancy: Physical chart shows Pit = 47; subscriber pricing sheet shows Pit = 51. The 4-seat difference is internally consistent: the 4 extra 'Pit' seats in venues.json reduce the non-pit orchestra sections by 4 relative to physical (600 sellable vs 604 physical non-pit non-Pit). Total hall count (908) is unchanged in both interpretations.

_needsHumanConfirmation.issue: Belding Pit seat count: 47 (physical chart) vs 51 (pricing sheet)
_needsHumanConfirmation.detail: The Belding Theater physical house chart shows the Pit row as 47 seats. The subscriber pricing sheet from which this file's Belding sections were derived shows 51. The hall total (908) is unchanged either way; the 4 seats shift between 'Pit' and the general orchestra pool. Most likely explanation: 4 pit positions are sold as standard front-row orchestra seats in the subscriber configuration.
